channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Paramount's WBD takeover 'is not a done deal,' says California's attorney general
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said the state's DOJ opened a probe into the merger, stating that it has "not cleared regulatory scrutiny."

item.title: Sam Altman says non-technical people can work on making AGI happen if they have taste
item.description: Sam Altman wrote on X that the "best research teams are built through context, taste and a real feel for where the field is headed next."

item.title: The internet can't get enough of Mamdani's meeting with Trump
item.description: The New York City mayor went to the Oval Office on Thursday with fake newspapers that got the president beaming.

item.title: Here's what smart people are saying about Paramount winning the Warner Bros. Discovery deal
item.description: Business and political leaders discuss the impact of the deal, from antitrust concerns to Netflix's big breakup fee.

item.title: A second airspace mix-up is unfolding over Texas as lawmakers say the US military shot down a Border Protection drone
item.description: Three Democratic lawmakers said the shootdown involved a "high risk" counter-drone system, in the second airspace incident this month over Texas.

item.title: Anthropic says it can't agree to the military's AI use terms — then it got slammed by an official
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said on Thursday the company "cannot in good conscience accede" to the military's terms over the use of Claude.

item.title: Jack Dorsey struck an 'empathetic' tone as he laid off nearly half of Block
item.description: The CEO's empathetic and transparent tone and a relatively generous layoff package, are gaining respect amid a 40% workforce reduction at Block.

item.title: OpenAI and Google employees have signed a petition opposing the military's AI use
item.description: OpenAI and Google employees are pushing back against Pentagon pressure for broader military access to AI models.

item.title: Videos show how Ukrainian helicopter crews use machine guns to hunt Russia's exploding Shahed drones
item.description: The Ukrainian navy released the footage on Thursday, saying the helicopter crew had destroyed eight Shahed and Gerbera drones in a single day.

item.title: I didn't learn 'Chinamaxxing' on TikTok — my Chinese mom taught me. Here are 4 habits I still swear by.
item.description: As a kid, Faye Bradley brushed off her Chinese mom's health advice. Now, she starts each day with a warm cup of water and refuses to go to bed with wet hair.
